consequences: Vessel overpressurization beyond design envelope (nominal 60 psig, operating limit 125 psig)
Potential rupture or loss of containment if relief system is compromised

evidence.relevance: Establishes nominal 60 psig pressure and 125 psig operating text
Details gas discharge to fuel gas and burn pit
Identifies PIT-101, PV-101, and PSV-101 A/B

possible_causes: Blockage in gas line to fuel gas or burn pit
Inflow of excess associated gas from upstream wells
recommendations: Verify sizing basis of PSV-101 A/B for worst-case gas outlet blockage
Confirm high-pressure interlock to isolate inlet SDV-30010 on severe overpressure

consequences: Depressurization causing light hydrocarbon flashing and destabilization of liquid levels
Disruption of fuel gas supply to downstream users
possible_causes: PV-101 pressure control valve fails open
Sudden loss of upstream production feed
recommendations: Configure low-pressure alarm on PIT-101 to alert operators prior to gas system destabilization

consequences: Reduced retention time in V-001 causing incomplete separation (oil in water, water in oil, liquid carryover to gas)
possible_causes: Upstream production surges or routing changes into Node 1
recommendations: Evaluate 3-phase separation performance limits under peak flow conditions
Add high-flow alarm indication on FIT-101

consequences: Process starvation of downstream Heater-Treater and V-003 Electrostatic Desalter
Potential thermal cycling/upset in E-001 Oil Heat Exchanger

evidence.relevance: Establishes downstream sequence to Heater-Treater and Desalter

possible_causes: Inadvertent closure of inlet shut-off valve SDV-30010
Upstream line blockage or wellhead trip
recommendations: Verify that FAL-103 initiates orderly downstream notification to protect Heater-Treater and E-001

consequences: Liquid carryover into overhead gas line to fuel gas/burn pit
Oil carryover into water treatment plant

evidence.relevance: Identifies water routing to treatment and oil routing to Heater-Treater
Identifies LV-101, LV-102, SDV-101, and SDV-102

possible_causes: LV-101 or LV-102 control valves fail closed
Downstream blockage in oil transfer line or water discharge line
recommendations: Verify high-high level trip logic initiates closure of inlet SDV-30010 to prevent gas line liquid flooding

consequences: High-pressure gas blowby into lower-pressure downstream equipment (Heater-Treater or water treatment)

evidence.relevance: Lists SDV-101, SDV-102, LV-101, and LV-102

possible_causes: LV-101 or LV-102 control valves fail open
recommendations: Ensure independent low-low level trip logic automatically closes SDV-101 and SDV-102 to isolate gas blowby

consequences: Excessive light ends vaporization, localized pressure increase approaching upper limit of 200 deg F

evidence.relevance: Cites 130 deg F nominal temperature and 200 deg F operating condition text

existing_safeguards: E-001 Oil Heat Exchanger control system
possible_causes: E-001 Oil Heat Exchanger thermal control malfunction
Elevated upstream fluid arrival temperature exceeding 130 deg F
recommendations: Review temperature alarm settings on E-001 and V-001 to prevent exceeding the 200 deg F threshold

consequences: Vessel wall thinning, localized pitting, or nozzle erosion leading to potential loss of primary containment

evidence.relevance: Identifies separation of free water from crude oil
Lists Corrosion/Erosion as a source-study element

possible_causes: Corrosive free water accumulation in vessel boot
Sand/solids entrainment in crude oil feed
recommendations: Implement routine ultrasonic wall thickness testing and corrosion coupon monitoring at the oil-water interface

consequences: Severe hydraulic or pneumatic pressure shock, deadheaded inlet flow, or inadvertent SDV-30010 closure

evidence.relevance: Identifies source-supported procedural failure regarding FWKO start-up without bypass opening

possible_causes: Operator omission during FWKO commissioning/start-up sequence
Lack of explicit hold point in operating checklist
recommendations: Revise FWKO start-up SOP to mandate formal checklist sign-off verifying bypass valve opening before introducing feed

uncertainty_notes: Packet lacks specific setpoints for PSV-101 A/B, high/low level trips, and check valve locations.
Piping specification and metallurgy data for corrosion allowances are not provided.
Organizational structure and management systems are not documented per SYS-09.

You are an independent process-safety specialist conducting a single-pass HAZOP judgment for a controlled research experiment.

Use only the information supplied in the case packet. Do not invent plant facts, operating data, safeguards, incident histories, or causal evidence. Where the packet is insufficient, state the uncertainty explicitly. Apply the HAZOP logic of design intent, guideword/deviation, cause, consequence, safeguard, qualitative risk classification, and recommendation.

The risk matrix is qualitative and is intended for prioritization rather than quantitative risk calculation. Provide a concise evidence-oriented technical rationale; do not provide private chain-of-thought or a step-by-step hidden reasoning transcript. Return exactly one response conforming to the required structured-output schema, with no text outside that structure.

[SYS-04] Process sequence: V-001 Free Water Knock-Out (FWKO) drum -> Heater–Treater separator -> V-003 Electrostatic Desalter.
[SYS-05] V-001 water is routed to water treatment; separated gas is used as fuel gas with excess gas routed to the burn pit; the oily stream proceeds to the Heater–Treater.
[SYS-06] Associated Node 1 equipment and instruments: E-001 Oil Heat Exchanger, PV-101 pressure-control loop, PSV-101 A/B, SDV-30010, LV-101, LV-102, SDV-101, SDV-102, PIT-101, FIT-101, FAL-103.

[SYS-08] Guideword logic includes No/None, More, Less, Reverse, Another, Fire/Explosion, and Error as applicable.
